mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which often leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the instances when HOUST declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 45% of the instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it indicates a favorable environment for economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO is rising and FEDFUNDS is below 2%.
